name: roamkeep
description: Roamkeep — private family location sharing. PWA + Capacitor Android shell.

scripts.sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:run: npm run sync && cap run android

scripts.android:bundle: npm run sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat bundleRelease
